vb_textbox.text: To begin with gnomes with specific colours will earn you more mushrooms on average (dark pink, dark purple, bright green) and others will earn you not as many (e.g. brown). In the second half of the experiment the reverse seemed to be true however. So when you move to the second half of the experiment, make the opposite choice that you would have made in the first round. It is possible that the rule change is random however, so watch out for changing probabilities (my impression was that things seemed to suddenly change in the second half).
